facts.fact: Ministerial order no 038974 of 6 November 2025 authorised Starlink Senegal Suarl (SpaceX subsidiary) to operate a fixed satellite internet access service for five years, on an ARTP specification.

Starlink Senegal was in official service by late March 2026 (the article cites osiris.sn: after official entry into service, ARTP warned in late March 2026 against resale via Starlink terminals); exact launch date not given.
Senegal's Supreme Court ordered the provisional suspension of Starlink Senegal's licence on 7 September 2026, on Sonatel's challenge to the 2025 order (reported 2026-09-09).
